llm.summary: This is a disclosed Chinese K12 chemistry lesson-planning skill with scoped class data use and teacher-confirmed outputs.

dimensions.detail: The skill uses platform memory and file capabilities for class profiles, weakness ranks, tiers, interaction logs, review plans, and lesson-plan drafts, but these are scoped to classroom planning and constrained by the schema.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains Markdown and JSON schema files only; no executable scripts, dependency installs, remote payload retrieval, or tool replacement behavior were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Activation is limited to chemistry plus lesson design, with explicit routing for lab procedures, notation drills, exams, and other subjects; generated lesson content is framed as teacher-reviewed draft material.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: It can write lessonPlans as pending entries after teacher confirmation and includes privacy controls for view, correction, deletion, pause, sharing, and export; it also instructs use of aliases or seat numbers instead of real student identifiers.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill’s purpose is chemistry lesson-plan drafting around macro-micro-symbolic representations, unit compression, and junior-to-senior transition lessons; its declared reads and writes support that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this only for the intended Chinese K12 chemistry-teaching context. Teachers should review lesson drafts, verify any AI-generated questions, and handle experiment details through the dedicated lab-safety workflow before classroom use.
llm.findings: [SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-language curriculum map matches the disclosed Chinese Mainland K12 teaching scope; shared platform guidance explicitly states the library is designed for Chinese K12 scenarios, so this is a localization/product-scope note rather than a security concern.
